title: Candidate C2 Active-Set Re-equilibration Diagnostic Evaluation (PBS 1416328.mmaster02)

KKT complementarity was verified with zero slack (lambda * delta_d = 0.0000000). Step 3 converged 15 cutback increments to step time t = 0.0947 (+50.1% further than Package 78) before terminating at dt < dt_min = 1e-12 in increment 16 due to localized crack-tip opening under unrelaxed prestress, reaching terminal RF2 = 5.18301 N (+58.68% vs donor 3.266150 N). Method C Gate C1-1 criteria remain strictly FAILED.
